nodes.name: .goreleaser.yaml
nodes.summary: GoReleaser v2 pipeline producing static pactify binaries for darwin/linux amd64/arm64 from ./cmd/pactify with SHA-256 checksums and GitHub release publishing.

nodes.name: .mcp.json
nodes.summary: MCP server registry declaring a `pact` server that invokes the `pactify mcp` command with PACT_AGENT_ID=claude for Claude Code integration.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent context for the `opencode-worker` seat covering session bootstrap, project overview, tech stack, and the pact MCP integration block managed by pactify.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Agent context for the `claude` seat (orchestrator + reviewer) with current sprint/version summary, key implementation details, and the pact MCP integration block.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Canonical GitHub-flow contribution guide for the Pactify repo: branch prefixes, conventional commits, merge-commit strategy, TDD discipline, and branch protection config.

nodes.name: GEMINI.md
nodes.summary: Agent context for the `gemini-worker` seat mirroring the opencode-worker context with session bootstrap, project overview, and the pact MCP integration block.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level project overview describing the pact protocol, install methods (curl|sh and go install), quickstart, Claude Code one-click install, and links to deeper docs.

nodes.name: go.mod
nodes.summary: Go module manifest for github.com/agentjoey/pactify (Go 1.26.1) declaring core deps: cobra, gorilla/websocket, modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk, fsnotify, pelletier/go-toml, and x/crypto.

nodes.name: go.sum
nodes.summary: Go module checksum database pinning exact hashes for the direct and indirect dependencies declared in go.mod to enable reproducible builds.

nodes.name: install.sh
nodes.summary: POSIX `curl|sh` installer that downloads the platform-specific pactify tarball + SHA-256 checksums.txt from GitHub releases, verifies, extracts, and installs the binary to ~/.local/bin or /usr/local/bin (re-signs ad-hoc on macOS).
nodes.languageNotes: POSIX sh (no bashisms), with a `PACTIFY_SOURCE_ONLY` early-return so test harnesses can source the helpers without running main.

nodes.name: opencode.json
nodes.summary: OpenCode agent configuration declaring the `pact` MCP server as a local command (`pactify mcp`) with PACT_AGENT_ID=opencode-worker.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Installer entry point: resolves the target version, fetches platform archive + checksums.txt, verifies SHA-256, extracts the pactify binary, picks an install dir, and on macOS re-signs ad-hoc + clears quarantine attrs.
